name: reverse-compact
description: A compact local analysis, profiling, benchmarking and evidence core with CLI, MCP, Windows and legacy Linux compatibility diagnosis (patches M/N).

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test dist-tests/*.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run docs:mcp:check && npm run quality:static && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=90000 dist-tests/capabilities.check.js && node tests/capability-report.mjs dist-tests/capability-report.json
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --experimental-test-coverage --test dist-tests/*.test.js
scripts.quality: npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run size:check && npm run quality:static && npm run lint && npm run dup:check && npm run unused:check && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.mutation: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && stryker run
